title: It is not obvious from the Hollow Throne room text alone that the 'rite' option requires first talking to the first Reeve's shade one room south in his tomb to obtain his confession; a player who fought straight through the honour guard to the throne without lingering there could arrive to find the rite option apparently unavailable with no on-screen pointer back.
